observatory.description: Each held Orb gives ×1.5 Mult when its Yaku family scores, once per Orb per play. Black Hole matches any scored Yaku.
observatory.holdingNote: Observatory rewards holding this Orb. Using it grants its permanent upgrade but removes this held bonus.

closedHandAusterity.name: Closed-Hand Austerity
closedHandAusterity.description: Complete concealed hands gain ×1.5, growing ×1.2 per earlier complete concealed hand this run, up to ×4 before Flower empowerment. Tactical plays and Shanten Clemency do not qualify.
closedHandAusterity.progress: Completed concealed hands: {{count}}. Next qualifying hand: ×{{factor}} before Flowers.

yakuRepetition.name: Yaku Repetition Charter
yakuRepetition.description: Each Yaku scored in consecutive rounds compounds ×1.2 per prior round in its streak (up to ×4 total). Missing a round breaks that Yaku’s streak. The cap is before Flower empowerment.
yakuRepetition.title: Patterns to repeat
yakuRepetition.empty: No prior streaks. Score a Yaku this round to start one.

consumableUnlocks.seal_of_the_void: Score all 20 Yaku types in a single run.

decreeUnlocks.decree-brainstorm: Win a run with at least five Decrees owned.
decreeUnlocks.decree-clone-army: Win a run on Gold Stake.
decreeUnlocks.decree-yakuman-blessing: Score three Yakuman patterns in one run.

scoreThresholds.supernova: ×2.5 Mult if this play brings the round score to at least twice the target, before Supernova and Perfectionist bonuses.
scoreThresholds.perfectionist: ×3 Mult if the first play clears the round, before Supernova and Perfectionist bonuses.

copyCosts.title: Copied powers and costs
copyCosts.rescue: A copied Phoenix spends the copier before the original. Eternal copiers cannot pay that cost. Immortal rescue keeps the Decree but sets your run’s score multiplier to ×0.5.
copyCosts.risk: An active Glass Cannon copy shatters with a lost Boss round too. Eternal protection prevents destruction.
copyCosts.limits: Once-per-round actions share one round limit; copies do not add uses.

randomCopy.description: Copies a random non-copy Decree on acquisition and at each round start.
randomCopy.missing: Target removed; choose again next round.
randomCopy.inactive: The copier or its target is inactive.
randomCopy.rules: The target stays fixed this round. Copies effects and costs, not editions or copy chains. Removing or disabling the target does not reroll it.

screenDownload.title: This screen couldn’t download
screenDownload.description: A connection problem or a new release may have interrupted loading. Check your connection, then save and reload to try again.
screenDownload.saveFailed: Couldn’t save safely. This tab has not reloaded. Check storage access and try again.
screenDownload.reloadFailed: Couldn’t start reloading. This tab is still open; try again.

runOwnership.fateSeal: Tile changes last for this run, including future rounds. A new run starts fresh.
runOwnership.negativeTile: +1 Decree slot while this physical Negative tile remains in your wall. Drawing or discarding it keeps the slot; destruction or replacing its edition removes it.
runOwnership.overCapacity: Capacity reduced: you keep your owned Decrees. Make room before acquiring more.

discard.title: Improve your hand
discard.content: REDRAW sends any number of selected tiles to the river and draws new ones. It costs a Turn unless you have a free redraw.

yaku.title: Patterns and multipliers
yaku.content: You can score with a small group; a complete hand can unlock Yaku multipliers. Check the score preview before deciding what to play and what to keep.

flora.title: Flowers & Seasons
flora.content: These tiles activate when drawn. Flowers last for the run; Seasons affect the current round. Inspect the Flowers / Seasons panel to see your active effects.

shop.title: The Tea House
shop.content: Your round's pay lands in the purse as you arrive; each toast says what it was for. Buy items that work together, or save for interest. Tap any item to see what it does before you buy it.

decrees.title: Decrees
decrees.content: Decrees stay with you and can change scoring, money, tiles, or which hands are allowed. Inspect their descriptions before building around them or selling them.

boss.title: Boss round
boss.content: A boss adds a special rule called a mandate. Read it before choosing your tiles; your usual plan may need to change.

decreeModifiers.eternalCannotSellNamed: {{name}} is Eternal and cannot be sold
decreeModifiers.eternalConflictDescription: Cannot prevent a loss: Eternal blocks this Decree from consuming itself.
decreeModifiers.perishableDescription: Loses its active effects when its countdown expires.
decreeModifiers.expired: Expired — its active effects are disabled.
decreeModifiers.rentalDescription: Costs {{amount}} gold at the end of each round.

classicSave.unavailable: Saving or loading is unavailable. Keep this tab open and try again.
classicSave.invalid: This run could not be saved or loaded. The stored checkpoint has not been changed.
classicSave.conflict: Saved progress changed in another tab. This table is paused.
classicSave.leaveBody: Save your run and return to the menu. You can resume it later.

consumableUse.errorMaxLevel: This upgrade is already at its maximum level.
consumableUse.errorNoRoom: Make space for the reward before using this item.
consumableUse.errorNoDecrees: You need an owned Decree for this effect.
consumableUse.errorNoPrevious: First use an item from {{seals}} or {{orbs}}.
consumableUse.errorNoGold: This effect would grant no gold right now.
consumableUse.hiddenOutcome: The outcome for concealed targets is checked only when you confirm.

consumableUse.penalty_halve_base_score: Halve base points for the next hand.
consumableUse.protected: Omen protection cancels the additional penalty.
consumableUse.errorSuit: Choose a suited tile of a different suit.
consumableUse.errorRank: Choose a suited tile whose new rank is between 1 and 9.
consumableUse.choose: Choose an item, then confirm its use.

consumableUse.replacesModifier: Replaces {{names}}: a tile holds one mark, seal or edition.
consumableUse.failed: This item could not be used.
consumableUse.unavailable: This item can’t be used right now.

fullUnlock.title: Full Unlock
fullUnlock.description: Unlock all items, tables and stakes. Achievement tracking will be disabled for this profile.
fullUnlock.confirm: Unlock all content? Existing achievements stay, but no more achievement progress will be recorded. Prices and run prerequisites still apply. Returning to earned progression requires Reset All Progress, which erases saved progress.
fullUnlock.active: Full Unlock is active. Achievement tracking is disabled. Reset All Progress to start a new earned profile.
fullUnlock.error: Could not save this change completely. Reload and check the profile mode before continuing.

settings.resetProgressScope: This also deletes discoveries and active or saved runs. Language, audio, and accessibility settings are kept.
settings.resetFailed: Reset failed. Your progress has been kept. Check browser storage and try again.
settings.resetPartial: Reset could not finish, and some progress may have changed. Check browser storage and try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.tileHintsDesc: Group your hand into Pairs, Sequences and Triplets under the rack, and point out a complete Mahjong hand
settings.resetTutorialDesc: Show the new player tutorial again
settings.resetTutorialSuccess: Tutorial has been reset. It will show on next visit.
settings.resetProgressDesc: Clear all achievements, statistics, and unlocks
settings.resetProgressConfirm: Are you sure? This will permanently delete all your achievements, statistics, and unlocks. This action cannot be undone.
settings.rankNumbersDesc: Show a small 1–9 on numbered tiles and a letter on Dragons, while you learn the tile faces.
settings.unreadableSave: Your saved run could not be read. You can download it as a file before starting a New Run, which replaces it.

gameplay.decreeDisabledByMandate: Disabled by Crimson Heart this hand

gameplay.firstMoveContentPattern: Glowing tiles: {{pattern}}. Select them, check the points, then Play. Open the book icon for the illustrated tile guide.
gameplay.firstMoveContentRedraw: Select the glowing isolated tiles and Redraw to find a group. Open the book icon for the illustrated tile guide.
gameplay.beginnerGuideIntro: You do not need to know a full Mahjong hand yet. In Tensho, begin by spotting one small shape and playing it for points.
gameplay.beginnerFamiliesHelp: Characters, Circles, and Bamboo run from 1 to 9. Winds and Dragons are Honors: match them, but never place them in a sequence.
gameplay.beginnerPairHelp: Two identical tiles. The easiest shape to recognize.
gameplay.beginnerSequenceHelp: Three consecutive numbers in the same suit.
gameplay.beginnerTripletHelp: Three identical tiles. Harder to find, but worth more.
gameplay.beginnerQuadHelp: Four identical tiles. Rare, valuable, and easy to recognize.
gameplay.beginnerFullHand: Later, four shapes plus one pair form a complete hand and unlock powerful Yaku multipliers.
gameplay.beginnerTapGlowing: Tap the {{count}} glowing tiles below. They already form a scoring shape.
gameplay.beginnerRedrawHelp: Tap the glowing isolated tiles, then press Redraw to look for a Pair, Sequence, or Triplet.
gameplay.beginnerRedrawReady: Ready — press Redraw to replace these isolated tiles.
gameplay.beginnerPatternComplete: Beautiful — this {{pattern}} earns +{{points}} shape points. Check the forecast, then Play.
gameplay.stageUnlockHint: Complete hands unlock a two-step Stage Hand declaration
gameplay.tacticalHint: Select {{min}}–{{max}} tiles for a tactical play
gameplay.tacticalHintLong: Select {{min}}–{{max}} tiles for a tactical play, or complete the hand before declaring it.
gameplay.completeToUnlockStage: Complete all {{count}} tiles to unlock Stage Hand

coach.title: Two ways to play this
coach.behindPace: Short of the {{required}} this hand needs.
coach.shapeCost: Scores {{difference}} fewer points now with one complete group. It does not predict future draws.
coach.tradeoff: Compare the tiles and scores. A suggestion only selects tiles; it does not spend a play.

gameplay.reasonMaximum: Up to {{count}} tiles, or a full Mahjong hand
gameplay.reasonMaximumRedraw: Play: up to {{count}} tiles or a full Mahjong hand. REDRAW: any number
gameplay.reasonUnavailable: This play isn’t allowed right now
gameplay.reasonLastTurn: Your last Turn must be a Play
gameplay.reasonNoReplacements: Not enough tiles left in the wall
gameplay.deadWallHint: Select exactly one tile, then swap it for a Dead Wall tile. Once per round, free.

catalyst.prompt: Trade one Flower for {{name}} instead of {{cost}}G.
catalyst.empty: Collect a Flower before making this trade.
catalyst.warning: The Flower is consumed; its powers return when collected again. Earned awakening is kept for this run. This Decree sells for 0G.
catalyst.loss2: Fewer than two Flowers: lose the bonus Decree slot.
catalyst.loss3: Fewer than three Flowers: Flower-powered shop and pack choices lock again.
catalyst.loss4: Fewer than four Flowers: Flower effectiveness returns to normal.
catalyst.noSpace: Make room for this Decree after the Flower slot is lost.

availability.decreeSpace: No Decree slot. Review your build to make room.
availability.flowers: More Flowers are required for this Decree.

build.title: Your build
build.empty: No Decrees yet. Purchased scrolls appear here.
build.sellPrompt: Sell {{name}} for {{gold}} gold? This removes it from your build.
build.saleFailed: The Decree could not be sold. Your build is unchanged.

shop.packInventoryFull: Not enough Decree slots for this selection. Sell a Decree, choose fewer, or skip the pack.
shop.inventoryFull: Not enough inventory space for this reward.
shop.title: Tea House

kinds.decreeHelp: A Decree is a permanent rule for this run. It takes one Decree slot; you can sell it any time.
kinds.sealHelp: Used the moment you take it: choose the wall tiles it changes, and they stay changed for the whole run.
kinds.sealHelpInstant: Used the moment you take it.
kinds.orb: Celestial Orb · upgrades a family of hands
kinds.script: Void Script · powerful, with a cost
kinds.consumableHelp: Kept with your items until used. Tap it on the table to use it.
kinds.tileHelp: Adds this tile to your wall for the rest of the run.
kinds.charterHelp: An Imperial Charter is a permanent upgrade for the rest of this run. It never takes a slot and can’t be sold.
kinds.orbHelp: Used the moment you take it: the family's level rises at once and stays up for the whole run.

help.what: The Tea House is the shop between rounds.
help.buy: Tap any item to see what it does, then press Buy. Decrees change the rules, Orbs and Seals work at once (a Seal asks which wall tiles to change), Scripts are used during a round, Packs let you pick rewards, and Charters upgrade the whole run.
help.interest: Gold you keep earns interest: +1 Gold for every 5 you hold when a round ends, up to +{{cap}}.
help.cashOut: Your round's pay lands in the purse as you arrive, one toast per source: the clear itself, interest, Decrees, Gold tiles and any rentals charged.
help.build: Your build shows the Decrees you own beside your Yaku upgrades: open a scroll to read its rules or sell it, or an upgrade to see its level. Every purchase happens with its own Buy button.

mutations.locked: Collect all four Flower types in one run to unlock rebloom. Then draw an owned Flower again to awaken it.
mutations.ready: Rebloom unlocked. Drawing an owned Flower again awakens it for this run.
mutations.plum: Once per play, two sequences may share one tile. A complete hand can use 13 tiles.
mutations.orchid: Dragons count as two Honors for Flower and Decree scoring. Tiles and Yaku groups are not duplicated.
mutations.chrysanthemum: Concealed plays gain ×{{factor}} per meld instead of the ordinary Chrysanthemum bonus. Pairs do not count.
mutations.bamboo: A 1 or 9 can anchor two adjacent ranks in a sequence. Tile faces and points stay unchanged.

details.plumRecovery: Plum returned tiles from the river: {{count}}. These are recovered tiles, not copies.
details.runScope: Collected Flowers last for this run. Uncollected bonuses are previews.
details.roundScope: Shown in draw order. Seasons expire after this round.
details.suppressed: Drought suppresses your Flower scoring bonuses.
details.protected: A Decree protects your Flower bonuses from Drought.
details.partial: Some Season rules are still being implemented. Only current effects are shown.
details.spring: +2 rack spaces this round. New spaces draw from the live wall. Stacks; Serpent still replaces only 3 tiles.
details.summer: Score ×1.3. Sets aside 20% of the remaining live wall for this round (retained tiles rounded down).
details.summerSheltered: Score ×1.3. Bamboo protection earned: Summer cannot shrink the wall again this round.
details.autumn: Yaku multiplier +20%. Each normal Autumn drawn gives 1 free REDRAW this round.
details.winter: Same-suit sequences may skip one rank (1–2–4 or 1–3–4). Score ×0.75.
details.drought: Suppresses Flower scoring bonuses unless protected.
details.frostbite: Each Frostbite halves Decree point, multiplier, gold and retrigger rewards again. Native tile rewards, rule permissions, capacities, action budgets and costs stay unchanged.
details.decay: −10 score for each REDRAW this round, never below zero.
details.monsoon: Randomizes normal draws and bonus replacements this round.
details.orchidBloom: Orchid drew extra tiles: {{count}}. Extra draws do not chain.
details.setThree: 3 Flowers: unlock Flower-powered Decrees in the shop and Decree packs.

tileDetails.numberedRule: Match identical tiles for a pair or triplet. Three consecutive numbers in one suit form a sequence.
tileDetails.honorRule: Honors form matching pairs or triplets, not numbered sequences.
tileDetails.basePoints: {{points}} base points before group bonuses, discounts and other effects.
tileDetails.dragonMult: +{{mult}} Mult, or +{{groupMult}} when it scores inside a group.
tileDetails.windGroup: {{points}} when it scores inside a group.
tileDetails.flowerScope: Base Flower effect; lasts for the run. Collection bonuses and suppression can change it. See Flowers / Seasons for active effects.

results.defeatIncome: On defeat, Rental is charged; round rewards, interest, Decree income and held Gold tile income are not paid.
results.victorySubtitle: The Act 8 Showdown is yours. Your run is secured.
results.endlessSubtitle: Your victory stands—even though this ascent has ended.
results.defeatSubtitle: Try a different plan on your next run.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tensho!
welcome.p1: <0>Tensho (天翔)</0> means "Heavenly Ascent" in Japanese. It is a <3>roguelike game</3> of <6>poker-style hands</6> played with Mahjong tiles.
welcome.p2: Your goal is simple: <2>build scoring hands</2> and reach the target score each round. Fail to reach the target, and your run ends.
welcome.note1: Don't worry if you've never played Mahjong before! This tutorial will teach you everything you need to know, step by step.

hands.title: Hands You Can Play
hands.p1: A play can hold up to {{max}} tiles. It scores as the best hand its tiles make:
hands.mahjong: A complete Mahjong hand adds +{{mult}} Mult on top of its Yaku.

ready.title: You're Ready!
ready.note1: You can <1>reroll</1> the shop offerings for 5 gold. Each reroll costs +1 more.
ready.note2: Holding <1>25+ gold</1> maximizes interest! But spending on good decrees is usually worth more.
ready.p1: Don't worry about memorizing everything — you'll learn by playing!
ready.note3: You can always return to this codex from the Settings menu if you need a refresher.

game_concept.p1: Unlike traditional Mahjong which is played against opponents, Tensho is a <1>single-player puzzle game</1>. You're racing against the score target, not other players.
game_concept.p2: Each run consists of multiple <2>Acts</2>, and each Act has <5>3 Rounds</5>. The score targets increase as you progress.
game_concept.p3: Between rounds, you'll visit the <2>Tea House</2> (shop) to acquire powerful <5>Decrees</5> that modify the rules and boost your scoring potential.

tiles_overview.p1: The game uses <1>144 tiles</1> in total:

numbered_suits.note1: Each standard tile appears <1>4 times</1> in the game. This is important for planning your hand!
numbered_suits.p1: There are <1>three numbered suits</1>, each with tiles ranked 1-9:
numbered_suits.p2: <0>Characters (萬子 / Manzu)</0> — Feature Chinese numerals with the character 萬 (wan, meaning "ten thousand")
numbered_suits.p3: <0>Circles (筒子 / Pinzu)</0> — Show circular patterns representing coins or dots
numbered_suits.p4: <0>Bamboo (索子 / Souzu)</0> — Depict bamboo sticks (the 1 of Bamboo shows a bird instead)

terminals_simples.p1: Numbered tiles are divided into two important categories:

wind_tiles.note1: Terminals are worth double the points of simples! Many yaku also specifically require or exclude terminals.
wind_tiles.p1: There are <1>four Wind tiles</1>, representing the cardinal directions:
wind_tiles.p2: Wind tiles are <1>Honor tiles</1> and are worth <4>50 points</4> each, 100 inside a group — the highest base value!

dragon_tiles.note1: Winds cannot form sequences. They can only form triplets or pairs.
dragon_tiles.p2: <0>白 (White Dragon / Haku)</0> — A blank or framed tile, representing purity or emptiness
dragon_tiles.p3: <0>發 (Green Dragon / Hatsu)</0> — The character 發 in green, meaning "prosperity" or "to emit"
dragon_tiles.p4: <0>中 (Red Dragon / Chun)</0> — The character 中 in red, meaning "center" or "middle"
dragon_tiles.p5: Dragons are <1>Honor tiles</1> worth <4>15 points</4>, and every Dragon that scores adds +2 Mult, +4 inside a group. They cannot form sequences.

bonus_tiles.p1: <0>Bonus tiles</0> are special tiles that don't form part of your hand:

sequences.note1: When you draw a bonus tile, it's immediately revealed and you draw a replacement tile. Flowers and Seasons provide scaling bonuses and effects!
sequences.p1: A <1>sequence</1> is <4>3 consecutive tiles of the same suit</4>.

melds_overview.p1: A <1>meld</1> (also called a "group" or "set") is a specific combination of tiles:
melds_overview.p2: Understanding melds is <1>essential</1> — your winning hand is made up of these building blocks!

quads.li1: Sequences must be in the <1>same suit</1>
quads.p1: A <1>quad</1> (also called "kong" or "kan") is <4>4 identical tiles</4>.
quads.p2: Quads are the rarest meld type since you need all 4 copies of a tile!

pairs.p2: Every standard winning hand requires <2>exactly one pair</2>. This is sometimes called the "head" (雀頭) of the hand.

winning_hand.note1: Triplets are worth <1>+40 points</1> — more than sequences (+30)! However, they're harder to complete since you need 3 of the same tile, and each tile only appears 4 times in the game.
winning_hand.li1: Worth <1>+65 points</1> — the most of any meld
winning_hand.li2: Counts as a single meld despite having 4 tiles
winning_hand.li3: When declared, you draw a replacement tile
winning_hand.p1: A standard winning hand consists of:

gameplay_overview.note1: The pair is worth <1>+15 points</1>. Any tile can form a pair — numbered tiles, winds, or dragons.

special_hands.p1: Two special hand structures don't follow the 4 melds + 1 pair rule:

drawing.p2: The <1>wall</1> starts with 70 drawable tiles (after the dead wall is reserved). Watch the remaining tiles counter!

base_points.note1: When you draw a <1>bonus tile</1> (Flower or Season), it's automatically revealed and you draw a replacement. This doesn't cost a turn!

yaku_intro.p1: <0>Yaku (役)</0> are special patterns that <3>multiply your score</3>. This is where the big points come from!
yaku_intro.p2: There are <1>21 yaku</1> in Tensho, organized into 4 tiers:

yaku_examples.p1: Here are some yaku you'll encounter often:

boss_mandates.p1: Every <1>Boss Round</1> has a special <3>Mandate</3> — a restriction or challenge:

decree_categories.note1: Yaku <1>stack multiplicatively</1>! A hand with ×1.3 and ×2.0 yaku gets ×2.6 total. Build combos for massive scores!

acts_rounds.p1: Your run is divided into <1>Acts</1>, and each Act contains <3>3 Rounds</3>:
acts_rounds.p2: Score targets increase with each Act. Act 1 starts easy, but by Act 8 you'll need powerful combos to survive!

decree_slots.note1: Some Decrees can help counter specific mandates. Plan your build accordingly!
decree_slots.li1: <0>Modify scoring</0> — Add multipliers or flat bonuses
decree_slots.li2: <0>Bend rules</0> — Change what makes a legal hand
decree_slots.li3: <0>Grant abilities</0> — Extra draws, redraws, or effects
decree_slots.p1: You have a limited number of <1>Decree Slots</1>. You start with <3>5 slots</3> and can earn more through:

decrees_intro.p1: <0>Decrees (法令)</0> are rule-modifying cards that persist throughout your run. Think of them as Tensho's equivalent of "Jokers" in Balatro.

flowers_system.p1: <0>Flowers</0> provide <3>permanent bonuses</3> that last your entire run:
flowers_system.p2: Collecting multiple flowers unlocks <2>set bonuses</2>: 2 flowers = +1 decree slot, 4 flowers = double flower effectiveness!

interest.note1: Higher rarity decrees are more expensive and rarer in the shop. Build synergies between multiple common decrees for powerful combos!
interest.p1: At the end of each round, you earn <2>interest</2> on saved gold:

hierarchy.p1: When effects conflict, Tensho uses a <2>hierarchy of authority</2>:

tips.note1: You can <1>sell</1> Decrees for gold. This frees up a slot and gives you half the purchase price back.

seasons_system.p1: <0>Seasons</0> are <3>temporary modifiers</3> that last only for the current round:

more_tips.note1: From Act 2 onward, <2>Corrupted Seasons</2> can appear with negative effects!
more_tips.li1: <0>Winning rounds</0> — Base payout scales with score
more_tips.li3: <0>Selling Decrees</0> — Get half the purchase price

tea_house.p1: After each round, you visit the <2>Tea House (茶寮)</2> to spend your gold:

turns.title: How a Round Works
turns.p1: Each round gives you {{turns}} Turns. Every Turn is one of two actions:
turns.play: score the selected tiles: up to {{max}}, or a whole Mahjong hand.
turns.redraw: send any number of selected tiles to the river and draw new ones.
turns.p2: Reach the round's target before your Turns run out. Your last Turn is always a play, and items can give free redraws that cost no Turn.
turns.warning: Run out of Turns below the target and the run is over.

refill.title: Drawing Tiles
refill.p1: Your rack refills from the wall after every play and every REDRAW, so you always have a full hand to choose from.

redraw.title: REDRAW
redraw.p1: Select the tiles you don't want, as many as you like, and press REDRAW. They go to the river and new tiles take their place.
redraw.li1: Free redraws from items are used first; otherwise a REDRAW costs one Turn.
redraw.li2: Redrawn tiles stay in the river for the rest of the round.
redraw.note: Keep the tiles that already make a group, and redraw the loners.

score.title: How Scoring Works
score.note: Bigger hands, Dragons, Orbs and Decrees all raise the Mult, and the Mult multiplies everything.

points.title: Tile Points
points.p1: Every tile in a group scores its points:
points.note: Winds are worth ten times a simple tile; Dragons add Mult instead. A pair or bigger group doubles either. A numbered tile outside any group scores half.

groups.title: Group Bonuses
groups.p1: Each group adds bonus points on top of its tiles:
groups.example: Example: Two Pairs = {{pair}} + {{pair}} = +{{total}} bonus points, and the second group adds +1 Mult.

swift.title: Swift Clears
swift.p1: Rounds can't be skipped. Clear a Small or Large round with {{spare}} or more Turns to spare to earn an Omen.
swift.li1: You still collect the round's Gold and visit the Tea House.
swift.li2: Boss rounds never give an Omen.
swift.note: A strong early hand saves Turns, and saved Turns become Omens.

three_dragons.name: Three Dragons
three_dragons.explain: One White, one Green and one Red Dragon. A secret hand.

four_winds.name: Four Winds
four_winds.explain: One each of East, South, West and North. A secret hand.

guide.title: How to play
guide.intro: Tensho is a poker-style game played with Mahjong tiles. Pick tiles that form a hand, play it for points, and reach each round’s target.
guide.redrawHelp: sends any number of selected tiles to the river and draws new ones.
guide.turnsHelp: Each round gives you {{turns}} Turns. Play hand and REDRAW each cost one. Clear a Small or Large round with {{spare}} Turns to spare to earn an Omen.
guide.scoreHelp: Points are the tiles’ values plus each group’s bonus. Mult starts at 1 and grows with bigger hands, Dragons, Orbs and Decrees. Numbered tiles outside a group score half.
guide.patternRule: Every group after the first adds +1 Mult. Triplets and Straights of Four add +1 more, Quads and Straights of Five +2. Each tile counts once; up to 6 tiles per play unless it is a full Mahjong hand.
guide.tilesHelp: Characters show Chinese numbers 一 to 九; Circles and Bamboo show their count (the 1 of Bamboo is a bird). You can turn numbers on the tiles on in Settings.
guide.honorsHelp: Winds are worth {{wind}} points each, {{windGroup}} in a group. Each Dragon adds +{{dragon}} Mult, +{{dragonGroup}} in a group.
guide.specialHelp: A coloured frame with a gem is a mark, a wax stamp is a seal, and a shimmer is an edition. A tile holds only one of them. Hover or focus a tile to read exactly what it does.

mandateConsequence.debuff_until_sell: All tiles score 0 until you sell a Decree

Pairs.name: Pairs
Pairs.covers: Pair, Two Pairs and Three Pairs

floraReveal.drawn: Drawn from the wall. Bonus tiles go straight to your collection, and a replacement tile is drawn into your rack.
